verdict.rationale: Segment documents routing events to a large destination catalog: 700+ apps per pricing, 550+ destinations for Connections, and a destinations catalog that lists Actions-based integrations such as HubSpot, Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Algolia Insights. The evidence never describes per-destination field mapping or per-destination event filtering, so only the catalog half of the story is shown. missing for 10: documented per-destination mapping configuration, documented per-destination filtering, independent or hands-on corroboration
